rules.evidence: Context package with sources, uncertainties and assumptions
rules.action: Define project context and domain boundaries.

rules.evidence: Purpose proposal, acceptance questions and review points
rules.action: Define project purpose, desired outcomes and acceptance questions.

rules.evidence: System model and use cases with open ambiguities
rules.action: Establish the system model and observable use cases.

rules.evidence: Alternatives, evaluation protocol and evidence-based comparison
rules.action: Establish benchmarks, test strategy and success criteria.

rules.evidence: Architecture proposal, decisions and handoff boundaries
rules.action: Define the high-level solution architecture and review its decisions.

rules.evidence: POC hypotheses, reproducible experiment, measured results and open risks
rules.action: Resolve the bounded POC uncertainty, or record why a POC is unnecessary.

rules.evidence: Sprint plan and task proposals for review
rules.action: Define and review the sprint plan and scoped tasks.

rules.evidence: Low-level design and actionable implementation contracts
rules.action: Specify low-level design and implementation contracts for the selected scope.

rules.evidence: Code-change and test-execution evidence with deviations and review handoff
rules.action: Work on sprint-scoped implementation and record build/test evidence.

rules.evidence: Independent review findings, release recommendation and human decision points
rules.action: Document the candidate and obtain independent review and release decisions.

rules.evidence: Operational reality, DevOps and user-acceptance evidence
rules.action: Establish operational and user-acceptance evidence in the real system.
Record observability findings and learning for the next cycle.
